breakdown.description: The varying traction is extended from the outer right edge to additional cutout surfaces selected by outward-normal orientation
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction regarding the traction boundary condition. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to apply traction to both the outer right edge and the inner vertical face of the cutout. The ground truth corrected this to apply traction *only* on the outer right edge (x=1). The agent's generated specification repeated the incorrect instruction, stating to apply the traction on 'the outer right edge x = 1 and the vertical face of the cut-out'.
